brief: Something to keep my sewing supplies tidy.

requirements.requirement: Keep sewing supplies tidy - organized storage
requirements.evidence: 3-cell cluster (0,0,0 0,1,0 1,0,0) with divided bins: 2x hex-bin-full-div2 (2 compartments each) + 1x hex-bin-full-div3 (3 compartments) = 7 compartments for threads, bobbins, needles, buttons, scissors etc.

finish.summary: Built compact sewing organizer: 3 full hex bases in L-shape with 7 compartments across 3 bins (two 2-compartment and one 3-compartment) to sort sewing supplies by type, keeping them tidy and visible.
